subject: assets
title: Exported to glTF and read back: the same models
note: model_export writes a recipe as a .glb for other engines. Each pair is the model built from its recipe beside the same model after export and import: a statue, a rigged creature and a patch of grass match in size and colour, and the terrain matches its re-import exactly. The first run showed the exported grass as solid dark cards (its blades are a baked cut-out texture the exporter did not write); textures now travel in the file. New in M5 (the export lane).
